an6.49:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an6.49:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca khemo āyasmā ca sumano sāvatthiyaṃ viharanti andhavanasmiṃ.
an6.49:1.3: atha kho āyasmā ca khemo āyasmā ca sumano yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā khemo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an6.49:2.1: yo so bhante bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññā vimutto tassa na evaṃ hoti
an6.49:2.2: atthi me seyyoti vā atthi me sadisoti vā atthi me hīnoti vāti.
an6.49:2.5: atha kho āyasmā khemo samanuñño me satthāti uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
an6.49:3.1: atha kho āyasmā sumano acirapakkante āyasmante kheme bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an6.49:3.2: yo so bhante bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññā vimutto tassa na evaṃ hoti
an6.49:3.3: natthi me seyyoti vā natthi me sadisoti vā natthi me hīnoti vāti.
an6.49:3.6: atha kho āyasmā sumano samanuñño me satthāti uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
an6.49:4.1: atha kho bhagavā acirapakkantesu āyasmante ca kheme āyasmante ca sumane bhikkhū āmantesi
an6.49:4.2: evaṃ kho bhikkhave kulaputtā aññaṃ byākaronti
an6.49:4.3: attho ca vutto attā ca anupanīto
an6.49:4.4: atha ca pana idhekacce moghapurisā hasamānakā maññe aññaṃ byākaronti
